def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    orders = db["orders"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]

    entities = list(entity_ids)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entities, name="product_id"))

    # ---- Доступная на seed_time история покупок ----
    items_past = order_items[
        (order_items["product_id"].isin(entities)) &
        (order_items["ts"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()

    # ---- Агрегаты по всей истории ----
    if not items_past.empty:
        agg_all = items_past.groupby("product_id").agg(
            n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            n_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
            total_price=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            mean_price=("price", "mean"),
            mean_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            min_ts=("ts", "min"),
            max_ts=("ts", "max"),
        )
        features = features.join(agg_all)
        features["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - features["max_ts"]).dt.days
        features["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - features["min_ts"]).dt.days
        features["active_days"] = (features["max_ts"] - features["min_ts"]).dt.days
        features["items_per_order"] = features["n_items"] / features["n_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
        features = features.drop(columns=["min_ts", "max_ts"])

    # ---- Скользящие окна (только прошлое) ----
    for win in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=win)
        items_win = items_past[items_past["ts"] > cutoff]
        if items_win.empty:
            features[f"win{win}_cnt_orders"] = 0.0
            features[f"win{win}_cnt_items"] = 0.0
            features[f"win{win}_sum_price"] = 0.0
            features[f"win{win}_has_sales"] = 0
        else:
            agg_win = items_win.groupby("product_id").agg(
                cnt_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
                cnt_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
                sum_price=("price", "sum"),
                mean_price=("price", "mean"),
            ).add_prefix(f"win{win}_")
            agg_win[f"win{win}_has_sales"] = 1
            features = features.join(agg_win)

    # ---- Тренд: продажи в последних 30 днях против предыдущих 60 ----
    c30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    c90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    recent = items_past[items_past["ts"] > c30].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    prev = items_past[(items_past["ts"] > c90) & (items_past["ts"] <= c30)].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    trend = (recent.reindex(features.index).fillna(0) /
             prev.reindex(features.index).replace(0, np.nan)).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    features["trend_recent_vs_prev"] = trend

    # ---- Признаки времени seed_time ----
    features["month"] = seed_time.month
    features["quarter"] = seed_time.quarter
    features["day_of_week"] = seed_time.dayofweek
    features["year"] = seed_time.year

    # ---- Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже опубликованы к seed_time ----
    if not items_past.empty and not reviews.empty:
        reviews_avail = reviews[reviews["review_answer_timestamp"] <= seed_time]
        order_rating = reviews_avail.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].mean().rename("avg_review").reset_index()
        prod_orders = items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        prod_orders = prod_orders.merge(order_rating, on="order_id", how="left")
        known = prod_orders[prod_orders["avg_review"].notna()]
        if not known.empty:
            rating_agg = known.groupby("product_id")["avg_review"].agg(
                review_mean="mean",
                review_min="min",
                n_reviews="count",
            )
            rating_agg["review_pct_good"] = known[known["avg_review"] >= 4].groupby("product_id").size() / \
                                            known.groupby("product_id").size()
            rating_agg["review_share_known_orders"] = rating_agg["n_reviews"] / \
                prod_orders.groupby("product_id").size()
            features = features.join(rating_agg)

    # ---- Логистика: только заказы, реально доставленные до seed_time ----
    if not items_past.empty:
        delivered = orders[(orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()) &
                           (orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)]
        delivered = delivered[["order_id", "order_delivered_customer_date",
                               "order_estimated_delivery_date"]]
        merged = items_past.merge(delivered, on="order_id", how="inner")
        merged["delay_days"] = (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"] -
                                merged["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.days
        merged["ship_days"] = (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"] - merged["ts"]).dt.days
        log_agg = merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
            mean_delay=("delay_days", "mean"),
            mean_ship_days=("ship_days", "mean"),
            n_delivered=("order_id", "nunique"),
        )
        features = features.join(log_agg)
        if "n_orders" in features.columns:
            features["delivered_share"] = features["n_delivered"] / features["n_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # ---- Финализация ----
    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0.0)
    features.index.name = "product_id"
    return features.astype(float)
